thread:
noah (sales): Hi all — Zenith Biotech needs a bridge acknowledgement and a SOC 2 excerpt before their infra team will start the Dedicated POC. They want a mutual NDA first and scoped read-only console + request logs for debugging. Fastest path? cc @bella (legal) @rahul (security)

 bella (legal): We can provide a redacted SOC 2 excerpt (opinion page, scope, control families). We won't share auditor workpapers, control IDs, or internal diagrams. I can draft a mutual NDA in DocuSign and attach the excerpt plus a one-page bridge letter.

 rahul (security): For access: issue a time-limited API key (48-72h) and/or a console read-only role for a fixed window. Raw logs OK only after PII review — we sanitize and watermark exports. We also require a signed recipient list.

 kai (eng): Eng needs a JIRA with the authorized emails and POC window to reserve a small GPU pool and pin model v2.0. We'll disable autoscale for the trial. Also need billing contact for trial credits.

 disclosure-bot: POLICY: Per SH-3, SOC 2 excerpts shared externally must exclude auditor workpapers and internal control identifiers. Create disclosure record when excerpt is released.

 noah (sales): Customer: zenithbio.com. Users: sara@zenithbio.com, miguel@zenithbio.com. I'll send DocuSign mutual NDA and ask if test data contains PII. DocuSign link: https://docusign.example/zenith-nda (will update).

 bella (legal): I'll prepare the NDA + redacted excerpt + bridge letter and aim to have the DocuSign package ready by EOD tomorrow. Ping me when signed.

 rahul (security): After signed NDA and disclosure record, we can provision the key/role within 24 hours. If logs include payloads, product-risk must sign off on redaction.

 noah (sales): Sent DocuSign. Will update when signed. Thanks team. :thumbsup:
